proof.criterion: A merge Legion submitted and GitHub has not completed within an hour tells the architect once
proof.surface: Two halves. The transactional half - the outbox runner holding a real ready_merge row under its lease against a real Postgres with real migrations - is this pull request's test job (the architect's A2: no pod has Postgres, and every outbox test skips without LEGION_TEST_PG_DSN). The decision half - the notice the architect is told, the store's validation of its new kind, and the causes that must warn nobody - I drove in this pod.
proof.command: gh run view 39923720122 --repo sjawhar/legion --log --job 120315442677, read for the daemon package's result; and a throwaway test of my own, go -C packages/daemon test ./internal/daemon -run TestTesterINFRA83MergeWaitingNotice -v (deleted after the run), calling readyMergeWaiting, record.NewOutboxRow and permanentRefusal directly.
proof.observed: ok github.com/sjawhar/legion/daemon/internal/daemon 438.485s, and again under the race detector (317.328s), the package holding TestAREADYMergeGitHubLeavesWaitingTellsTheArchitectOnce: zero notices on the unadvanced clock, exactly one an hour later with the row still present, its payload warned, its next_at ahead and its last_error still GitHub's BLOCKED, the issue still in awaiting_merge, and still exactly one an hour after that. In the pod: the notice's kind is merge-waiting and its role the architect, the store accepts the row, and the reason names #42, ready-head, 1h1m0s, awaiting_merge, 'has not been withdrawn' and GitHub's last answer. permanentRefusal is true for ghautomerge.Refused and ghautomerge.Removed and false for a plain wait, which is what keeps a row that ends and tells the architect itself (merge-refused, merge-removed, merge-stalled) from telling it twice. I also read the surrounding code: RetryOutbox updates attempts, next_at, last_error and the lease alone, so the Warned flag the warning writes survives every retry, and a reopen's requeue clears it deliberately (the plan's D4).

notesForTheArchitect: Not a failure, and yours to decide: packages/daemon/internal/prompts/go/worker-common.md:19 now tells every worker that a code push carrying a wrong skip-checks trailer leaves 'a head with no CI is one GitHub will not merge, so the merge waits and the daemon tells the issue's architect once it has waited an hour'.
